messages:
ashley: Nightdash alert popped at 03:01 UTC — opportunistic-batching heartbeat errors + spike. Throughput -12% across the 4AM window, p99 latency +30%. stack: throughput/latency dashboards.

mike: ack, pulled logs. I see repeated `heartbeat_timeout` in runtime logs from batch-scheduler on worker-12.

nisha: any recent merges touching batch scheduler or heartbeat intervals?

sam: @nisha yeah, merged PR #3274 yesterday that changed opportunistic batching to poll every 50ms instead of 20ms to reduce CPU. landed in release/edge.

tara: that sounds suspicious — increasing poll interval could delay heartbeat detection. can someone grep for `poll_interval_ms` in the canary?

mike: running quick profile on canary, attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-18T02:58:11Z worker-12 scheduler: check loop took 48ms
2026-03-18T02:58:11Z worker-12 scheduler: heartbeat detected lag 120ms
2026-03-18T02:58:12Z worker-12 batching: opportunistic flush deferred by 60ms
```

ashley: CI had a perf job fail last night but marked as flaky. job: nightly-perf/opportunistic-batching. logs show more `heartbeat delayed` in the exact stage.

sam: starting a git bisect on release/edge between commit before #3274 and after. IF we confirm, we'll revert.

mike: quick check: metrics for worker-12 show more small batches (<=2 requests) in the spike window — suggests delayed coalescing.

nisha: can we reproduce locally with a small cluster? I can run a 3-node dev harness with traffic replay from the 03:00 window.

tara: pls also run `DEBUG_SCHEDULER=1` to get detailed timestamps. that helped last time.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused: release/edge v2026.3.18-373 due to performance alert (opportunistic-batching-heartbeat).

sam: bisect results: commit 9f2c3b1 (PR #3274) is the first bad commit. reproduces in dev-harness.

mike: confirmed locally with traffic replay. changing poll from 20ms->50ms increases avg heartbeat lag by ~28ms and p99 by 20-35% depending on traffic shape.

ashley: decision: revert PR #3274 in staging, hold canary. tagging @oncall-runtime for awareness.

nisha: rolling revert now: `git revert -m 1 9f2c3b1 && bazel build //runtime/... && deploy canary`. ETA ~12m.

tara: after revert, add test in nightly-perf to assert p99 within baseline for opportunistic batching profile.

sam: follow-up action: create small unit that simulates variable arrival jitter and assert scheduler keeps heartbeat < 40ms under typical load.

mike: adding runtime metric `scheduler.poll_interval_effective_ms` to help future debug. will add to Optimize dashboard.

deploy-bot: Canary resumed: revert-of-9f2c3b1 deployed to canary at 03:21 UTC.

ashley: monitoring... p99 trending back down within 10m of resume. closing alert if stable for next 30m. thanks team :thumbsup:

mike: filing a follow-up PR to make poll interval adaptive (based on load) rather than a static bump — cc @nisha, @sam for design.

ashley: good notes. we'll post a short postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow with timeline and action items.
